change_reason: Recognize explicit terminal Final numeric answer: and Final numeric answer only: labels already used by the shared math prompt; preserve v1 results and rescore all methods consistently from raw outputs

text.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace; preserve punctuation and English articles
text.tokenization: Unicode words and individual non-whitespace punctuation tokens
text.multiple_references: Answer union Accepted_answers; independently maximize EM and token F1 over references
text.strict_em: NFKC plus collapsed whitespace, preserving case and punctuation; supplementary diagnostic
text.unanswerable: RAG canonical UNANSWERABLE requires the complete normalized prediction to equal UNANSWERABLE; no partial credit for an explanatory sentence

math.tolerance_rationale: Use a fixed absolute tolerance so an integer answer off by one is not accepted merely because the reference is large
math.comparison: absolute error <= max(abs_tol, rel_tol * max(abs(prediction), abs(reference)))
math.forms: signed integer, decimal, scientific notation, valid grouped thousands, fraction, whole-expression LaTeX frac
math.percent: Group output convention, matching the shared prompt: a trailing percent sign denotes percentage points, so 60% equals 60, not 0.6; this is not a general mathematical percent conversion
math.extraction: complete numeric response, or complete numeric content after a terminal explicit Answer/Final answer/Final numeric answer/Final numeric answer only marker; never search intermediate calculations for a matching number
math.wrappers: Only complete enclosing code fences, bold, math delimiters or boxed braces can be removed
math.failure: blank, malformed, unparseable or known-truncated response becomes empty extracted Answer and scores zero

alignment: Require exact input/reference/prediction ID sets; duplicates, missing or extra IDs fail explicitly
reporting: Per-task EM/F1 or numeric accuracy in percent; row scores in 0..1; all rows remain in the denominator
selection_score: Equal mean of QA EM, RAG EM and math numeric accuracy, only when all three tasks are present
test_access: CLI final-test mode additionally requires final_test_frozen=true in the shared model configuration
